CVE-2026-112300.title: configobj: configobj: Denial of Service via inefficient regular expression evaluation
CVE-2026-112300.description: A flaw was found in configobj. A remote attacker can trigger a Denial of Service (DoS) by supplying specially crafted configuration input to be parsed by the application. Due to inefficient regular expression evaluation in the _sectionmarker function, processing this input causes excessive CPU consumption and application unresponsiveness.
